audit_fixes: Reject unregistered or modified private runtime before process execution.
Reject infinities in native template flux and scatter; do not classify infinity as a mask.
Align report rows by filenames and use expected log-velocity differences in paired summaries.
Check all native stages and both training perturbation signs; reject stale/nonfinite report residuals.
failure_context: smoke3 and smoke4 were development attempts with noiseless training velocities [-300,0,300] m/s. They failed at build1 on the middle epoch covariance and were not included among seven completed cases. The successful fixture was changed during development to [-300,-100,400] m/s. Their full RVO and stdout are retained below; these earlier transient driver versions were not frozen, so no exact source-bound replay claim is made for those failures.
limits: One generated order fitted; three chip tables are duplicates, not independent measurements.
Fixed three updates after initial template; no convergence criterion adopted.
Unity tellurics, symmetric Gaussian LSF, fixed wavelength map; not a detector-level injection.
Near-unity paired slopes coexist with template zero-point offsets; they do not establish absolute RV fidelity.
Only two noisy realizations; no coverage or scientific threshold calibration.
Trusted external source copied into private runtime with no-op plotting wrapper; not an OS access-control sandbox.
Generated FITS and full private source/runtime products are ignored local scratch; retained numerical evidence and hashes support rebuilding, not a self-contained executable archive.
Observational controls, protocol freeze, independent governance, and target-access gates remain unresolved.
